capabilities.name: Core document loading and media types
capabilities.covered: Both historical standalone Codecept PDF-loading journeys are retired: Playwright smoke proves local fixture loading, rendered page readiness, canvas dimensions and navigation, and supports the migrated local-AAT launch path. Functional tests exceed them with image loading, PDF replacement/rendered page identity and unsupported-media diagnostics
capabilities.gap: Live AAT/DM Store retrieval and Office conversion are reported separately; audio/video playback is tracked under Multimedia playback

capabilities.name: AAT document prerequisites
capabilities.execution: Live API contracts run by default; the three browser contracts are excluded by EXUI-5123 until the owning CCD upload defect is fixed
capabilities.covered: Three Playwright Integration contracts prove PDF, image and Word uploads through the live DM Store API; three matching Playwright Integration browser contracts preserve the historical CCD upload journeys and are tagged with EXUI-5123 until the owning CCD upload form is fixed
capabilities.gap: No legacy migration gap. EXUI-5123 is an external CCD browser defect: the three tagged Playwright contracts remain discoverable but are deliberately excluded from normal selection until the mandatory Document field binds successful uploads

capabilities.name: CCD case creation prerequisite
capabilities.execution: The live API contract runs by default; the browser hand-off contract is excluded by EXUI-5122 until the owning CCD route is fixed
capabilities.covered: A Playwright Integration contract creates a real CCD case through the live API; a matching Playwright Integration browser contract preserves the authenticated case-details hand-off and is tagged with EXUI-5122 until the owning CCD route is fixed
capabilities.gap: No legacy migration gap. EXUI-5122 is an external CCD browser defect: the tagged Playwright contract remains discoverable but is deliberately excluded from normal selection until an authenticated caseworker can open the case-details route

capabilities.name: Office document conversion
capabilities.covered: Playwright submits a Word conversion request and proves the returned PDF renders
capabilities.gap: No legacy migration gap. The current viewer does not render deterministic conversion-failure diagnostics, and the success test uses a document-assembly route fake; live document-assembly/AAT integration remains a separate assurance boundary

capabilities.name: Page navigation
capabilities.covered: All historical Codecept scenarios are retired. Playwright covers next/previous, page input, rendered page identity, viewport state and document boundaries
capabilities.gap: Bundle and nested-document destination coverage is provided by Index and outline; no remaining legacy migration gap.

capabilities.name: Zoom
capabilities.covered: All historical Codecept scenarios are retired. Playwright covers PDF/image round-trip and minimum/maximum scale boundaries
capabilities.gap: No remaining high-value gap identified in this standalone slice

capabilities.name: Rotation
capabilities.covered: All historical Codecept scenarios are retired. Playwright covers PDF orientation and image transform round-trips using intrinsic rendered state, reset after PDF document replacement, default-state reset after reload for both media types, and restoration of server-supplied PDF orientation metadata
capabilities.gap: The standalone demo exposes no Save rotation action; persistence writes require a separate integration surface rather than a fabricated UI journey

capabilities.name: Search
capabilities.covered: All historical Codecept scenarios are retired. Playwright covers positive search, next/previous, no results, close/reset, recovery, Enter navigation and rendered highlight-all, exact-case and whole-word option contracts
capabilities.gap: No remaining high-value gap identified in this standalone slice

capabilities.name: Comments panel
capabilities.covered: All historical Codecept scenarios are retired. Playwright covers direct-toolbar panel lifecycle; create, update, removal and cancel semantics; immediate and rehydrated rendered state; stale-highlight reset, no-result and multi-result search; cross-page search navigation; rendered summary/page-link navigation; document-isolated persistence; and selected-text/two-comment summary coverage supplied by PDF annotations
capabilities.gap: No remaining high-value gap identified in this standalone slice

capabilities.name: PDF annotations and comments
capabilities.covered: All seven historical Codecept UI scenarios are retired. Playwright covers real PDF text selection, distinct draw-box geometry through reload, request and rendered geometry, comment persistence through rotation and rehydration, two-comment collation, every search result highlighted into a persisted annotation set, and deletion of every existing highlight through individual annotation DELETE requests
capabilities.gap: No legacy migration gap. The functional suite uses deterministic annotation API fakes; add an AAT service contract for the live annotation service boundary

capabilities.name: Image annotations and comments
capabilities.execution: Update and delete Functional UI contracts plus the live Integration lifecycle run by default; the two create/draw-browser contracts are excluded by EXUI-5124 until image draw-box annotations persist
capabilities.covered: Four Playwright Functional contracts preserve the historical user behaviours one-for-one: create a non-text image annotation and comment, draw-box geometry, comment update and comment deletion. A Playwright Integration contract proves annotation-set creation, annotation create/retrieve/update/delete against the live annotation service after DM Store image upload
capabilities.gap: No legacy migration gap. EXUI-5124 records the reproducible product defect: a real image draw-box gesture does not produce a persisted rendered annotation. The two affected UI contracts are discoverable and must be re-enabled with PLAYWRIGHT_INCLUDE_KNOWN_DEFECTS=true once the fix is available

capabilities.name: Bookmarks
capabilities.covered: All eight historical Codecept bookmark scenarios are retired. Playwright covers real text-selection contextual bookmark creation, panel creation, update, delete with sibling promotion, single and multiple empty drafts, document-position/custom sorting, rendered drag-reorder persistence and 30-bookmark lifecycle with deterministic bookmark API fixtures
capabilities.gap: No legacy migration gap. The functional drag-reorder contract is executable on master; live AAT/preview service-boundary evidence remains separate from this deterministic API fixture

capabilities.name: Index and outline
capabilities.covered: Both historical Codecept outline journeys are retired. Playwright uses the repository's 22-page bundle fixture to navigate Index Page to page 2 and the nested Prepared Discharge Final Order to page 8, asserting the rendered page input and selected parent/child outline state
capabilities.gap: No remaining legacy gap identified in this standalone slice

capabilities.name: Print and download
capabilities.covered: Both historical PDF action-only Codecept scenarios are retired. Playwright reaches the visible toolbar or overflow menu, proves the loaded PDF URL is handed to the print API, and proves PDF.js hands the same URL plus configured filename to the browser download contract
capabilities.gap: Native browser print dialogs and download-manager UI are browser-owned; the functional contract asserts the exact hand-off inputs rather than treating a platform dialog as product state

capabilities.name: Redaction
capabilities.covered: Playwright covers all 12 historical redaction scenarios through real draw-box and text-selection gestures, combined markers, full-page and multi-page redaction, single-marker and clear-all deletion, preview state, search/redact-all persistence, redaction request payload, downloaded PDF filename and post-download reset. It exceeds legacy coverage with exact multi-page save aggregation, clear-all persistence across reload and multi-page selective-delete/reload contracts. The contracts add positive geometry, page identity, persistence and exact deletion assertions
capabilities.gap: The browser suite uses deterministic markup and redaction-service responses; add AAT/service-contract evidence before claiming live-service equivalence

capabilities.name: Multimedia playback
capabilities.covered: Both historical Codecept scenarios are retired. Playwright exceeds their action/screenshot coverage with MP4 readiness, real MP3 play/pause/rewind state transitions through keyboard interaction, disabled-player download behaviour and unsupported-media diagnostics
capabilities.gap: No remaining high-value gap identified in the standalone multimedia-player slice

capabilities.name: In-court presentation (ICP)
capabilities.covered: Component-level product tests exist, but no browser journey is claimed
capabilities.gap: The current follower does not deterministically synchronise zoom and rotation from a socket update. Add leader/follower browser coverage after a separate product fix, then prove the live session-service and Web PubSub integration boundary
